tools.name: list_my_projects
tools.description: List the projects the calling user can see, newest first. Optional status filter (NEW, IN_PROGRESS, UNDER_REVIEW, COMPLETED, ARCHIVED, ON_HOLD).

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Fetch a single project by id (UUID) or project number (P-XXXXX), including client, billing, and assignment fields the caller may see.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Keyword search across the caller's projects (title, client name, description).

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project. Auto-assigns the next project number. Defaults: status NEW, priority MEDIUM, assignee = caller. CLIENT-role users cannot call this. Optional customFields (object keyed by the workspace PROJECT custom-field key — validated + stored under metadata.customFields) and recurrenceRule (RRULE subset).

customFields.description: Map of PROJECT custom-field key -> value; validated against the workspace definitions.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Patch a project. Identify by id or projectNumber. Only the fields you pass are updated. organizationId reassigns the project (pass null to detach). CLIENT-role users cannot call this. Optional customFields (object keyed by the workspace PROJECT custom-field key — validated + merged into metadata.customFields, preserving other metadata) and recurrenceRule (RRULE subset; null clears it).

customFields.description: Map of PROJECT custom-field key -> value; validated and merged into metadata.customFields.

recurrenceRule.description: RRULE subset; null clears the recurrence.

tools.name: update_project_status
tools.description: Move a project to a new status (NEW, IN_PROGRESS, UNDER_REVIEW, COMPLETED, ARCHIVED, ON_HOLD).

tools.name: update_billing_fields
tools.description: Update a project's billing and invoicing fields (invoice number, amounts, payment status, billing dates, notes).

tools.name: list_my_tasks
tools.description: List tasks assigned to or visible to the caller. Optional status and project filters.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Fetch full detail for a single task the caller can see (via its parent project): description, status, priority, type, due/completed dates, estimatedHours, metadata, assignee, creator, parent task, comment/subtask counts, and dependency edges (dependsOn + blocks). Requires taskId.

tools.name: list_project_tasks
tools.description: List tasks on one project the caller can see. Identify the project by projectId or projectNumber (either may hold a UUID or a human project number). Paginated: limit defaults to 25 (max 100), offset defaults to 0; ordered by priority desc, dueDate asc, createdAt desc. Optional status (PENDING / IN_PROGRESS / WAITING_FOR_CLIENT / COMPLETED / CANCELLED) and priority (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / URGENT) filters. Returns { project, tasks, count, total, offset, limit }.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task under a project. Requires projectId (UUID) or projectNumber. Optional type, status, priority, dueDate, assignee, parentTaskId (subtask under an existing same-project task). Optional customFields (object keyed by the workspace TASK custom-field key — validated + stored under metadata.customFields), recurrenceRule (RRULE subset, e.g. "FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=1", makes this a recurrence template), and estimatedHours (effort estimate used by capacity planning).

parentTaskId.description: Optional parent task id; must exist in the same project (workspace-visible).

customFields.description: Map of TASK custom-field key -> value; validated against the workspace definitions.

estimatedHours.description: Effort estimate (hours) used by capacity planning.

tools.name: list_task_subtasks
tools.description: List direct subtasks of a parent task the caller can see (via its project). Ordered by priority desc, dueDate asc, createdAt desc. Returns { parent, subtasks, count }.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Patch a task. Required: taskId. Only the fields you pass are updated. projectId or projectNumber reparents the task to a different project the caller can see. CLIENT-role users cannot call this. Optional customFields (object keyed by the workspace TASK custom-field key — validated + merged into metadata.customFields, preserving other metadata), recurrenceRule (RRULE subset; null clears it), and estimatedHours (null clears it).

customFields.description: Map of TASK custom-field key -> value; validated and merged into metadata.customFields.

recurrenceRule.description: RRULE subset; null clears the recurrence.

tools.name: update_task_status
tools.description: Move a task to a new status (PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_FOR_CLIENT, COMPLETED, CANCELLED).

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task by taskId. ADMIN only — same RBAC as REST DELETE /tasks/:id. Hard delete (unlike archive_project for projects).

tools.name: add_task_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task on the caller's behalf.

tools.name: list_task_comments
tools.description: List comments on a task the caller can see (paginated: limit default 50 max 100, offset default 0).

tools.name: update_task_comment
tools.description: Update a task comment by id. Author or ADMIN only (same ownership as REST).

tools.name: delete_task_comment
tools.description: Delete a task comment by id. Author, ADMIN, or MANAGER only (same ownership as REST).

tools.name: submit_candidate_action_items
tools.description: Submit a batch of candidate action items (e.g. extracted from a meeting transcript) for triage into tasks. Each item carries the action text plus optional owner and source linkage.

tools.name: list_project_documents
tools.description: List documents attached to a project.

tools.name: get_document_content
tools.description: Fetch the extracted text content of a project document.

tools.name: upload_document
tools.description: Upload a document to a project. Stored in the project-ops-documents bucket.

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Patch document metadata (description, tags, fileName). Does not rewrite storage fields. CLIENT users cannot.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Permanently delete a document (DB row + MinIO object when uploaded). CLIENT users cannot.

tools.name: get_recent_activity
tools.description: Return the caller's recent activity across projects and tasks (audit feed).

tools.name: start_timer
tools.description: Start a running work timer for the caller on a project or task. Stops any existing running timer first.

tools.name: stop_timer
tools.description: Stop the caller's running timer. Computes duration, rounding, rate, and billable amount.

tools.name: log_time
tools.description: Log a manual time entry. Provide startedAt+endedAt, startedAt+durationMinutes, endedAt+durationMinutes, or durationMinutes. Identify by projectId or taskId.

tools.name: update_time_entry
tools.description: Update a DRAFT, unlocked, unbilled time entry (id required). Locked/billed entries are immutable.

tools.name: delete_time_entry
tools.description: Delete a DRAFT, unlocked, unbilled time entry (id required). Locked, billed, or non-DRAFT entries cannot be deleted. Owner or ADMIN/MANAGER.

tools.name: list_time_entries
tools.description: List visible time entries, newest first, paginated. Filters: userId, projectId, taskId, from, to, billable, billed, approvalStatus. CLIENT never sees cost rates.

tools.name: submit_timesheet
tools.description: Submit the caller's weekly DRAFT entries for approval (week containing periodStart; default this week).

tools.name: approve_time
tools.description: Approve a submitted period (timesheetPeriodId) or specific entries (timeEntryIds). Locks approved entries. MANAGER/ADMIN only.

tools.name: get_utilization
tools.description: Billable vs total hours per user over an optional period (from/to). Optionally narrow to one userId.

tools.name: create_billable_draft
tools.description: Roll up APPROVED, billable, unbilled time for a projectId or clientId into invoice line items and (when Accounting-Ops is connected + entitled) create the invoice idempotently; otherwise return a draft + PDF preview. MANAGER/ADMIN only.

tools.name: sync_invoice_status
tools.description: Pull invoice status (sent/partial/paid/overdue) from Accounting-Ops for billed entries and mirror it onto the linked projects.

tools.name: get_portfolio_report
tools.description: Per-project health roll-up + workspace totals: budgeted vs logged hours, accrued billable vs budget amount, % complete, status, and an over-budget flag. Scoped to the projects the caller can see. Read-only.

tools.name: get_profitability_report
tools.description: Per-project + workspace profitability: billable amount, cost basis, margin, margin %, and realization (billed/billable) over an optional from/to ISO window. Exposes internal cost/margin, so MANAGER/ADMIN only. Read-only.

tools.name: get_throughput_report
tools.description: Tasks + projects COMPLETED over a window, bucketed by ISO week, plus a status breakdown of tasks created in-window. Defaults to the trailing 12 weeks when from/to are omitted. Read-only.

tools.name: get_team_capacity
tools.description: Per-user committed hours (sum of estimatedHours on in-window, not-done assigned tasks) vs pro-rated weekly capacity across a date window (defaults to the current week), with over-allocation flags + workspace totals. A planning surface — MANAGER/ADMIN only. Read-only.

tools.name: get_my_capacity
tools.description: The calling user's OWN committed load vs capacity over a date window (defaults to the current week). Any active member may call it; a non-member is refused. Read-only.

tools.name: list_automations
tools.description: List the workspace automation rules, newest first. Optional filters: trigger (TASK_CREATED, TASK_STATUS_CHANGED, TASK_ASSIGNED, TASK_COMPLETED, PROJECT_CREATED, PROJECT_STATUS_CHANGED, COMMENT_CREATED) and enabled. MANAGER/ADMIN only.

tools.name: create_automation
tools.description: Create a rule { name, trigger, conditions[], actions[] }. trigger is one of the AutomationTrigger values. conditions is an optional array of { field, op (eq|neq|contains|gt|lt), value } — ALL must match (AND). actions is a required non-empty array of { type, params }; type is one of assign_task / set_status / add_comment / create_task / notify. enabled defaults to true. MANAGER/ADMIN only.

tools.name: set_automation_enabled
tools.description: Toggle a rule on or off by id without changing its trigger/conditions/actions. MANAGER/ADMIN only.

tools.name: delete_automation
tools.description: Permanently delete an automation rule by id. MANAGER/ADMIN only.

tools.name: list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the workspace custom-field DEFINITIONS for an entity (key, label, type, options, required, position), ordered by position then label. Required: entity ('TASK' or 'PROJECT'). Use the returned keys when setting customFields values via create_task / update_task / create_project / update_project. Read-only.

tools.name: list_project_approvals
tools.description: List ALL client approvals on a project — the requesting staff's view of live client decisions (pending first). Requires projectId. Staff only (CLIENT-role users cannot call this).

tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Request a client approval on a document / deliverable / project (status PENDING). entityType is one of the ApprovalEntityType values; entityId is the id of the thing being submitted. Optional projectId (drives client scoping), approverContactId (a specific contact; else any portal client on the linked project's contact may act), and note. Staff only (CLIENT-role users cannot call this).

resources.description: Single project with tasks and documents
